name: Carlo Fidanza - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on how to secure a sustainable future for the EU livestock sector in light of the need to ensure food security, farmers’ resilience and the challenges posed by animal diseases?
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the future of EU livestock farming. It is not a law. It asks the European Commission to keep farm support money, cut paperwork, help young farmers, and defend farmers against unfair imports. It wants better animal disease prevention, including vaccination, and fewer mass culls. It also asks for clearer food labels and support for farming in mountains and remote areas.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its views and requests.
- **Who it affects:** Livestock farmers, meat and dairy workers, consumers, and rural communities.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
